## Schema extraction for Team 5 {#app-team5 .unnumbered}

The many-analysts football study of @silberzahn2018, analysed in the main
paper, uses a pre-extracted methodology text for each team, rather than the
original report, as the input to schema extraction. The text used for Team 5 is quoted below, and
@lst-team5-schema gives the schema extracted from it, as an illustration of
both the input and the output of the extraction stage.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
txt <- readLines(here::here("schemas/team5.txt"))
txt <- txt[!(seq_along(txt) > length(txt) - 3 & !nzchar(trimws(txt)))]
cat(ifelse(nzchar(trimws(txt)), paste0("> ", txt), ">"), sep = "\n")
cat("\n")
```

:::{#lst-team5-schema lst-cap="The schema extracted from the Team 5 methodology text quoted above. Two steps are returned with medium confidence, each carrying the clarification question the model would put to the analyst."}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
cat("````yaml\n")
cat(readLines(here::here("schemas/schema-team5.yaml")), sep = "\n")
cat("````\n")
```
:::

@lst-team5-code gives the script generated and validated from that schema,
completing the pipeline from methodology text to executable code for this
team. As in the main paper, the generated script is annotated with the
schema step each block implements.

:::{#lst-team5-code lst-cap="The R script generated and validated from the schema in @lst-team5-schema."}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
cat("````r\n")
cat(readLines(here::here("schemas/script-team5.R")), sep = "\n")
cat("````\n")
```
:::

## Ablation study: schema-based vs direct-generation pipelines {#app-abl .unnumbered}

## Built-in prompts {#app-prompt .unnumbered}

:::{.callout-note}

# Prompt: Extracting the schema from the text

```{r echo = FALSE}
tines::prompt_extract_schema(text = "[inset text here]", data_dict = NA)  
```

:::

:::{.callout-note}

# Prompt: generating code from the schema

```{r echo = FALSE}
tines::prompt_gen_code()
```
:::


:::{.callout-note}

# Prompt: validating the code generated 

```{r echo = FALSE}
cat(strwrap(tines:::build_sys_prompt(data = "[insert the path to the data]"), width = 70), sep = "\n")
```
:::

:::{.callout-note}

# Prompt: generating alternatives for a specific step

```{r echo = FALSE}
tines::prompt_alternatives(step = "[inset step number here]")
```

:::
